title: feat(hamdyn): Hamming-parity formation halts at T=4 with 9 locks
science: Single-member dynamics halt census, not a probe cell: Hamming parity f_H=|c|_1 mod 2 on the twelve-vertex two-cube from the 1-site seed halts at T=4 with |locks|=9 and does NOT fill, the three survivors being (0,1,1),(1,1,1),(2,1,1) (all even-weight tuples). Carries one genuinely discriminating observation: f_H and f_L1 have the SAME first wave (the three axis sites, weight-1 tuples being both odd
